rationale: The only contract workspace edit updates the development-only fast-uri lockfile entry from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9. No field, event, schema, fixture, registry or generated artifact changes, and no compatibility classification is introduced.
trust_boundary: The contract producer, consumer, tenant and event authority boundaries remain unchanged. The existing CI trust boundary is restored by withholding private Sonar execution from fork and Dependabot PRs; no restricted secret is copied or exposed. The development toolchain lockfile remains the existing bounded frozen-contract exemption.
transformation_ownership: The canonical contract source remains the sole generation input, and existing generators retain ownership of their derived artifacts. URI parsing remains in the existing AJV development toolchain; no production transformation or public contract mechanism is introduced or moved.

alternatives.rejection_reason: A development dependency patch and enforcement of an existing CI trust rule change no event semantic or contract representation. Calling this an extension would invent a compatibility change.
No new producer-consumer contract is needed to update an existing transitive development dependency or gate an existing private analysis job.
